definitions.explanation: A very dark shade of brown, close to black. A traditional Japanese color name used to describe clothing, hair, furniture, and other objects.

examples.japanese: {黒茶|くろちゃ}の{革靴|かわぐつ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought dark brown leather shoes.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}を{黒茶色|くろちゃいろ}に{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えたら、{部屋|へや}が{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた{雰囲気|ふんいき}になった。
examples.english: After repainting the walls dark brown, the room took on a calm atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{山|やま}の{木々|きぎ}の{葉|は}が{赤|あか}や{黄|き}、{黒茶|くろちゃ}に{色|いろ}づく。
examples.english: In autumn, the leaves on the mountain trees turn red, yellow, and dark brown.

notes:
Composed of {黒|くろ} (black) and {茶|ちゃ} (tea; brown). One of the traditional Japanese color names ({和色|わしょく}), describing a brown so dark it approaches black. The {茶|ちゃ} component refers to the color brown (from tea), not to tea itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒茶色|くろちゃいろ}: dark brown color (with the {色|いろ} suffix)
- {黒茶|くろちゃ}の{髪|かみ}: dark brown hair
- {黒茶|くろちゃ}の{家具|かぐ}: dark brown furniture

RELATED COLOR TERMS:
- {茶色|ちゃいろ}: brown — the standard brown
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}: dark brown — similar; evokes the color of scorched things
- {栗色|くりいろ}: chestnut brown — warmer, reddish-brown
